description: Search existing public job postings by title, nearby or remote work, and compensation preferences. Pay preferences help narrow or rank results; lower or unknown pay can still appear and does not establish a guaranteed minimum. Remote does not establish country eligibility. Returns up to 20 listings with a continuation cursor and LAYIQ job links. For more results, copy the complete response.cursor verbatim into the next search_jobs call and keep all search filters identical. Never shorten or reconstruct the token. No private account access, saved searches, personal Fit calculation or application submission. Explicit company filters are unavailable.

cursor.description: For the next page, copy the entire previous response.cursor string verbatim and repeat the same search filters. Never shorten, decode, reconstruct or edit the cursor. Omit it to start a new search or change filters.

location.description: City or region for near/near_remote searches. Remote/anywhere have no location restriction.

market.description: Location mode: near requires a location; near_remote adds remote roles; remote and anywhere cannot enforce a location restriction. Defaults to near_remote with a location, or anywhere without one.

minimumCompensation.description: Annual compensation preference, such as 120k. Helps narrow or rank results; lower or unknown pay can still appear and does not establish a guaranteed minimum.

query.description: Job title or title keywords. Ask for a title if it is missing.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles for near/near_remote, as a string. Defaults to 50. Not applied to remote/anywhere searches.

name: search_jobs

cursor.description: Complete opaque continuation token. If non-null, copy it verbatim into search_jobs.cursor with the identical search filters to retrieve the next page. Never shorten, decode or reconstruct it.

title: Search jobs on LAYIQ
